items.summary: Recommendation: hold discretionary spend, ROI claims, and new monetization admissions until attribution and cost coverage are sufficient. Amazon data covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, all attached to aggregate tracking_id other; site-attributed income is $0. Revenue claims, contribution margin, CAC, and ROI are therefore unsupported. AI spend was $10.8396 on 2026-10-01 across 11 of 38 expected sites; infrastructure spend, labor allocation, monthly budget, and spend limits are blank or unavailable. Preserve the existing capacity gate and run only report-only financial reconciliation using existing telemetry.

Keep the $4.92 Amazon commission unattributed. Do not assign aggregate ordered items, shipped items, or income to any site. Require registered site tracking IDs and a dated provider export before reporting site revenue or margin.

Do not admit work based on revenue, ROI, or payback forecasts. After capacity clears, the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA test may proceed only as a measurement experiment: baseline 61 affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, 0 shipped items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21; no financial upside is assumed.
